title: Operator spreading and recoverability of local quantum Fisher information in a $U(1)$-broken spin chain
summary: While out-of-time-order correlators establish a causal light cone for operator spreading, they do not guarantee that the parameter sensitivity carried by the operator remains locally recoverable. We examine the distinction between operator spreading and metrological recoverability for a parameter encoded in a single site of an XX spin chain subjected to a $U(1)$-breaking transverse field. We evaluate three levels of local metrological accessibility: the bare single-site quantum Fisher information (QFI), the QFI recovered by a variational sweep decoder acting on a finite spatial block, and…
